subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Which remaining slices should OpenClaw own in core/docs after the already-implemented bind precedence, token-fragment guidance, dry-run preview, and audit ledger pieces are excluded?
rationale: The unresolved work crosses stable setup, update, SecretRef/auth, and audit surfaces, and maintainers need to choose product scope before an implementation can be safely queued.

options.title: Split remaining scope
options.body: Keep the implemented pieces as satisfied and split the remaining systemd SecretRef docs, update config diff, and broader audit semantics into narrow maintainer-owned follow-ups.

options.title: Design a broader core workflow
options.body: Define a larger core update/deploy/audit workflow first, accepting that it will touch compatibility-sensitive CLI, config, and service-management behavior.

options.title: Keep scripts external
options.body: Treat the reference scripts as external operator guidance unless maintainers identify a missing core API or docs obligation.

recommendation.title: Split remaining scope
recommendation.body: Keep the implemented pieces as satisfied and split the remaining systemd SecretRef docs, update config diff, and broader audit semantics into narrow maintainer-owned follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available local routing signal across the affected current-main files points to Peter Steinberger, though ownership confidence is limited by the shallow snapshot-like history.
